name: @stubbedev/jenkins-mcp
description: MCP server for Jenkins build status and logs (Go, distributed as a prebuilt binary)

scripts.smoke: go build -o jenkins-mcp . && ( printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"smoke","version":"1"}}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'; sleep 1 ) | JENKINS_URL=https://smoke.invalid JENKINS_USERNAME=smoke JENKINS_TOKEN=smoke ./jenkins-mcp | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const r=d.trim().split(/\n/).map(l=>JSON.parse(l)).find(x=>x.id===2);if(!r)throw new Error('no tools/list response');if(r.error)throw new Error('server error: '+r.error.message);const t=r.result&&r.result.tools;if(!Array.isArray(t)||!t.length)throw new Error('no tools in response');const bad=t.filter(x=>!x.name||!x.inputSchema);if(bad.length)throw new Error('malformed tools: '+bad.map(x=>x.name||'(unnamed)').join(', '));console.log('smoke OK — '+t.length+' tool(s): '+t.map(x=>x.name).join(', '))}catch(e){console.error('smoke FAIL:',e.message);process.exit(1)}})"
scripts.preversion: go vet ./... && npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
